{"task": {"id": "I_kwDONElfw88AAAABYlB1aA", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4BlV6PzhCJ8IY", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4BlV6P", "number": 94, "title": "Prepare the next @takahirox/three-mmd npm release for one-command manual publish", "body": "## Problem

The maintainer wants to **update and publicly release `@takahirox/three-mmd`** with the recent MMD/physics work, but wants this task to stop **immediately before the real npm publication**. The completed result must be a clean, versioned release candidate on `main` for which the maintainer only needs to execute the documented **`npm publish`** command (subject to their npm login/authorization/2FA).

Current checked-in [`package.json`](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/blob/main/package.json) and lockfile still declare **`@takahirox/three-mmd@0.1.0`**. The previous [#45](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/issues/45) prepared an **initial** release rather than an update. External npm-package indexes now show 0.1.0, but their status may be cached; **verify the current public npm registry directly before selecting the next version**. npm does not allow publishing the exact same package/version again. Do not assume that an old 404 in `docs/releases.md` is still current.

Latest `main` when filing: `62d1476f45258f0063ceccdcb5ad46455d3ab218` (PR #93 merged; PMD/PMX physics policy unified). Other changes since prior release preparation include the newer official Bullet-backed WASM distribution, MotionState-first kinematic synchronization, initial animation influence ramp, and physics integration improvements.

The maintainer has performed **limited** manual motion testing and has not verified that intermittent severe PMD physics instability is resolved. They report no obvious regression so far and wish to make a release despite this **known unresolved limitation**. Neither visual approval nor a physics-stability improvement should be required or claimed by this release-preparation task.

## Expected outcome

Prepare and merge a **real next-version npm release candidate** so that **no further code, package metadata, documentation or CI edits are needed before the maintainer can run `npm publish` from an up-to-date, clean `main`**. The release should include current committed code and required runtime WASM assets, reflect actual supported features accurately, and pass the established release gates.

The single final publication action remains **reserved for the maintainer**. **Do not execute a real `npm publish`, create npm credentials/secrets, automatically release from CI, or represent the package as already published.** `npm publish --dry-run` is in scope.

### Pre-merge acceptance criteria

- [ ] Check the **public npm registry online**, bypassing stale caches, for `@takahirox/three-mmd` versions/dist-tags. Distinguish missing package, network errors, and permissions from successfully verified publication. Select the next unused semver version (e.g. **0.1.1 if 0.1.0 is the latest and 0.1.1 is unused**), update **both `package.json` and `package-lock.json`**, and validate internal version consistency. Never reuse an existing published version.
- [ ] Verify that current `main` changes through #93 are actually included, and the candidate records the **exact source commit/version** and a concise release summary. Mention material changes since 0.1.0, including Bullet WASM/runtime packaging, animation/physics updates and PMD/PMX unification. Describe rare PMD physics instability as **still under investigation**, without claiming it has been fixed. Do not block on resolving it or on further subjective motion testing.
- [ ] Update stale release-facing README and [`docs/releases.md`](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/blob/main/docs/releases.md) wording where needed: package no longer described as necessarily *unpublished/awaiting first release* if registry confirms otherwise; correct version, supported Three.js peer range, runtime dependency, root/subpath imports, externally initialized consumer Ammo, and the **optional packaged pinned Bullet JS/WASM** and usage/paths. Preserve the existing GitHub repo name and Pages URL.
- [ ] Build the exact distributable package and inspect `npm pack --dry-run --json` (and if needed an actual local `npm pack` without publication). Verify `exports`, type declarations, all declared runtime JS, `dist/vendor/bullet` glue/WASM/manifest, notices/LICENSE and any Worker runtime actually needed by consumers are included with correct paths. Verify the checked-in Bullet build identity and required redistributable licenses. Exclude private or licensed third-party MMD assets, fixtures, example downloads, local viewer files, secrets and unrelated development artifacts.
- [ ] Validate clean-install package use: JS ESM + strict TypeScript consumers install the packed tarball **without referring to source aliases or a published version**, import the package root and every documented subpath, and initialize real Ammo/Worker paths as applicable. Confirm no accidental new mandatory peer/runtime dependency; do not update supported Three.js range unless required and explicitly justified.
- [ ] Run and record the repository's applicable automated checks on this release candidate: `npm ci`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm test`, `npm run test:legacy`, `npm run test:browser`, `npm run build`, `MMD_EXAMPLE_FIXTURES=1 npm run build:examples`, built-site/Examples tests, `npm pack --dry-run` and **`npm publish --dry-run --access public`**. Check that `prepack` / `prepublishOnly` correctly execute packaging, type checks and offline test gates and abort on failures. Browser/fixture validation must not upload test-generated assets to Pages or npm.
- [ ] Confirm `publishConfig.access=public` and npmjs.org registry, no `private:true`, no automatic npm publication workflow/token/secret, and a publish lifecycle that does not depend on undocumented interactive repo changes. Do not disable lifecycle scripts or use `--force`/version overwrite.
- [ ] Document a **short final maintainer handoff**: selected version, source/merge SHA, registry evidence, passing CI/dry-run evidence, any remaining non-blocking known limitations, and the **single exact final command `npm publish`** from clean, updated `main`. Explicitly separate **external maintainer prerequisites** (npm login, publishing rights for `@takahirox`, npm 2FA/token as required) from repository readiness; agent cannot authenticate for the maintainer. Explain the post-publication npm registry version check as an **optional action after they publish**, not as this task's completion requirement.
- [ ] Merge the prepared release-candidate changes and verify the **latest attempt** of merge-triggered CI for that merge SHA where possible. Do not claim checks passed unless verified. No actual npm release, maintainer visual inspection, confirmed physics improvement or npm authorization is required to close this issue.

### Required post-merge verification

- **PENDING until performed:** Confirm the latest attempt of merge-triggered **Tests** and **GitHub Pages** workflows for the merged release-prep SHA, with status/conclusion and versioned source evidence. Pages is a separate deployment; it must not be confused with npm publishing.
- **PENDING until performed:** If public Examples or served package-related assets change, confirm the published Pages commit, JS/WASM paths and basic real-browser startup for PMD, Gene Light PMX and Worker Examples. Record results; these are **post-merge checks, not pre-merge requirements**, and do not assert physics stability.
- **Not part of this task:** Actual `npm publish` to the registry, npm authentication/2FA, checking the *new version* on npm **after** it has been published, creating a post-publication release tag, and the maintainer's visual judgment of intermittent physics breakage. Those occur only after the maintainer deliberately performs publication.

## Context

- [Previous initial-release preparation #45](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/issues/45), [release guide](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/blob/main/docs/releases.md), [package.json](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/blob/main/package.json), [CI workflow](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/blob/main/.github/workflows/tests.yml).
- [Latest physics unification PR #93](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/pull/93), [initial-pose warmup PR #91](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/pull/91), [kinematic MotionState PR #89](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/pull/89), and [new Bullet default PR #87](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/pull/87).
- The public npm package name is **`@takahirox/three-mmd`**, **not** the unrelated unscoped `three-mmd-loader`. Keep publishing a **manual maintainer action**, not an automated CI consequence.
